invariants.rationale: A new TextureRegion object is constructed and returned, so result cannot be null.
images.get(name) is called, which requires 'name' to be non-null to avoid a possible NullPointerException.
The TextureRegion result wraps the Texture from the image obtained via images.get(name).
result is constructed as new TextureRegion(images.get(name)), so it is equal per .equals to a new one constructed the same way.
